title: Why an arranger in a big band doesn't play
summary: With Lunceford and others he wrote for others and pushed the band rather than soloing, so nobody knew he could play.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: When I was with those bands, I was busy writing for other guys and I didn't play -- nobody knew I could even play the horn.
I never played the horn (inaudible), but I didn't play it. (Inaudible).
You just played in the section?
Yeah, write for the other guys and try
to push the band, trying to make the band, see?

And I didn't play. Like now, they think, well, (inaudible) this and that and this and that, but you can't play like that in the big band. If you're the arranger, you don't write things too much for yourself. You got to get that band off.
